# yt-dlp Windows executable

This folder contains the official Windows x64 binary `yt-dlp.exe`, release
2026.10.26. Its SHA-256 is:

`f5389d3698ecde4ef06f4e6b1ce0294fe9ac1396228c8990b8d3416d6d177a7d`

The binary was obtained from the official yt-dlp GitHub release and verified
against the SHA-256 published there. Development resolves it from this folder;
packaged Windows builds copy it to `resources/yt-dlp/yt-dlp.exe`.

When updating, use only the official release page, verify the published hash,
and update the version/hash in this README and the project README. The app never
downloads or updates this executable automatically.
